consolidated_description: An old, begrimed, and blistered blacksmith aboard the ship who patiently repairs weapons and tools for the crew despite a ruined past and physical affliction.
The captain of the ship, for whom Perth crafted or repaired an artificial leg.
A metaphorical figure personifying alcoholism and addiction, which ruined Perth's family, career, and household.
Perth's blacksmithing equipment retained on the deck of the ship.
